crossRefs.note: He entered into a boat, and crossed over, and came into his own city.
When Jesus returned, the multitude welcomed him, for they were all waiting for him.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: When Jesus had crossed back over in the boat to the other side, a great multitude was gathered to him; and he was by the sea.
translations.bsb: When Jesus had again crossed by boat to the other side, a large crowd gathered around Him beside the sea.
translations.kjv: And when Jesus was passed over again by ship unto the other side, much people gathered unto him: and he was nigh unto the sea.
translations.asv: And when Jesus had crossed over again in the boat unto the other side, a great multitude was gathered unto him; and he was by the sea.
